name: Debating
overview: Scripture warns against engaging in disputes that stem from folly or pride, emphasizing the importance of listening carefully before responding, as Proverbs 18:13 teaches. While the early church engaged in daily discussions of the faith (Acts 19:9), believers are cautioned to avoid unprofitable controversies and strivings about the law that lead to division rather than edification (Titus 3:9; Romans 14:1). Above all, Christ’s command to love one another (John 13:34) guides how believers should approach differences, prioritizing unity and care over conflict (Colossians 2:1).
